title: Any S-morphism between schemes weakly etale over S is itself weakly etale
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a scheme S and morphism f : X -> Y over S with X and Y both weakly etale over S, the lemma concludes f is weakly etale. The retained proof is written: writing f as X -> X x_S Y -> Y, the second map is flat as a base change of the flat map X -> S; the first map is the base change of the flat diagonal Y -> Y x_S Y along X x_S Y -> Y x_S Y, hence flat; so f is flat. For the diagonal of f, the map X x_Y X -> X x_S X is an immersion, and the chapter's key lemma (lemma-key, flatness reflected from a closed subscheme along an immersion onto the diagonal) turns flatness of X over X x_S X into flatness of X over X x_Y X. Both halves of the definition of weakly etale then hold. Retained author proof at lines 19170-19182.
